newsitem.title: JAPAN: Acer group to more than double China sales - report.
newsitem.headline: Acer group to more than double China sales - report.

text.p: Taiwan's Acer group expects to more than double its sales in China in 1996, Tuesday's Asian Wall Street Journal quoted a company official as saying.

Such growth would lift the firm's sales volume in China to between 55,000 and 60,000 personal computers (PCs) and its revenue there to about $75 million, Terry Liu, president of Acer Marketing Services in Beijing, told the paper in an interview.
Liu forecast that Acer's sales in China next year would grow to equal the company's sales in the Taiwan market, where it sold 80,000 PCs last year, the paper said.
He said the China market would be several times larger than Taiwan's in a few years.
